name: Instrumentation and Analytical Methods in Bioengineering
description: Advanced microscopy techniques (fluorescence microscopy), spectrofluorimeter, real-time PCR, 2-D gel electrophoresis, genomic analyses, gas chromatography with FID and TCD, Dionex HPLC with ECD and CD, HPLC and FPLC, protein chromatography, elemental analyzer, microfluidic chip fabrication, microfluidic programming and set-up.
